cmake_minimum_required(
    VERSION 4.2.0
    FATAL_ERROR
)

project(external-SDL3
    VERSION 3.4.12
    DESCRIPTION "Simple DirectMedia Layer"
    HOMEPAGE_URL "https://www.libsdl.org/"
)
include(ExternalProject)

list(APPEND SDL3_CMAKE_ARGS
    "-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX:PATH=${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}"
    "-DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE:PATH=${CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE}"
    "-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}"
    "-DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=${CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD}"
    "-DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=${CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED}"
    "-DCMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS=${CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS}"
    "-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS}"
    "-DSDL_STATIC=ON"
    "-DSDL_SHARED=OFF"
    "-DCMAKE_DEBUG_POSTFIX=d"
    "-DSDL_X11=OFF"
    "-DSDL_INSTALL=ON"
    "-DSDL_TEST_LIBRARY=OFF"
    "-DSDL_TESTS=OFF"
    "-DSDL_EXAMPLES=OFF"
)

if(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    list(APPEND SDL3_CMAKE_ARGS
        "-DCMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION_DEBUG=${CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION_DEBUG}"
        "-DCMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION_RELEASE=${CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION_RELEASE}"
    )
else()
    list(APPEND SDL3_CMAKE_ARGS
        "-DCMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION=${CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION}"
    )
endif()

message(STATUS "Preparing external project \"SDL3\" with args:")
foreach(CMAKE_ARG ${SDL3_CMAKE_ARGS})
    message(STATUS "-- ${CMAKE_ARG}")
endforeach()

ExternalProject_add(
    SDL3
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL.git
    GIT_TAG release-3.4.12
    PREFIX SDL3
    CMAKE_ARGS "${SDL3_CMAKE_ARGS}"
)
